source: Central Electricity Authority, Ministry of Power, Government of India — Executive Summary on Power Sector, September 2026, published 2026-10-27.
notes: September 2026 energy requirement was 269,586 MU, 17.5% above 229,405 MU a year earlier (CEA, provisional). Energy supplied grew 17.4%. The Ministry of Power weekly bulletin for 13–19 November 2026 separately reported peak demand met growth of 14.0% and energy consumption growth of 11.5%; weekly and monthly measures are not directly comparable.
